description: This file defines the BagPartDisplayDriver class, a content part display driver for managing BagPart content items in OrchardCore CMS. It includes methods for displaying, editing, updating, and authorizing access to BagPart content, utilizing dependency injection, content management, and authorization services.

classes.name: BagPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A content part display driver for BagPart, handling display, editing, updating, and authorization logic for BagPart content items.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Generates the display result for a BagPart, choosing between 'BagPart' or 'BagPart_Empty' based on content items.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the editor shape for BagPart, including contained content types and accessible widgets.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles updating the BagPart content items based on user input, managing creation, merging, and deletion with authorization checks.

methods.name: GetAccessibleWidgetsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves widgets that the current user can view, edit, or delete, with authorization checks.

methods.name: AuthorizeAsync
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to perform an action on a content type or content item.

methods.name: GetContainedContentTypesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves content types that can be contained within the BagPart, considering stereotypes and permissions.

methods.name: GetCurrentOwner
methods.description: Returns the user ID of the current owner from the HTTP context.
